SELECT
  afd_state,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM logs
WHERE classified_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY afd_state
ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(mttr_seconds)/60, 1) AS mttr_minutes,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN command_used = 'FALSE_POSITIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1
  ) AS false_positive_rate
FROM feedback_corrections
WHERE corrected_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';

SELECT message, COUNT(*) as occurrences
FROM logs
WHERE afd_state IN ('ERROR', 'CRITICAL', 'ERROR_CASCADE')
AND classified_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY message
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 5;
